media.description:
WhatsApp is a messaging app for personal and group communication through a direct, chat-based interface. It supports text messaging, voice calls, video calls, and media sharing, allowing real-time conversation between individuals or groups. Messages, attachments, and calls are handled within the same interface, without requiring separate tools. 

A chat list organizes ongoing conversations, showing recent activity and keeping frequently used threads accessible. Each chat supports text messages, images, videos, documents, voice notes, and location sharing. The interface presents these elements within a linear timeline that preserves context and makes exchanges easy to follow. Message indicators show when content has been sent, delivered, or viewed, giving users a clear sense of message status as interactions progress. 

Group functionality enables multi-party communication with tools for naming groups, assigning profile images, and managing participants. Administrators can add or remove members, adjust permissions, and determine who may send messages or modify group details. Groups support the same media types as individual chats, allowing coordinated sharing among teams, families, or other communities. Broadcast lists extend this system by sending one-to-many messages that appear as private conversations to recipients who have the sender’s number saved. 

Voice messages offer an alternative when typing is impractical. Users can record short or extended voice notes that appear directly in the chat timeline and can be played at adjustable speeds. The app also includes high-quality voice and video calling that operates through an internet connection. Calls support one-to-one conversations as well as group calls, giving users multiple ways to connect depending on context. 

Contact management draws on the device’s address book, allowing new chats to begin with minimal setup. A search function supports locating past messages, documents, links, and media by keyword, providing efficient retrieval of information from extended histories. Starred messages offer another retrieval method by marking important items for quick access. Together, these tools help maintain continuity in conversations that evolve over long periods. 

Media handling is central to the messaging experience. Photos, videos, and documents sent or received in chats can be viewed in galleries organized by file type, enabling users to revisit shared materials without scrolling through entire message histories. Forwarding options allow redistribution of items to other chats, with forwarding indicators helping recipients understand the origin of the content. Storage management tools assist in reviewing and removing large files or clearing specific chat histories to free device space. 

Privacy features offer granular control over visibility and interaction. Users can choose who may see their profile photo, status updates, and last-seen information. Read receipts can be enabled or disabled depending on communication preferences, and blocked contacts are prevented from calling or messaging. Two-step verification adds an optional security layer by requiring a PIN when registering the number on a new device. 

Status updates allow users to share photos, text, or short videos that remain visible for twenty-four hours to selected contacts. These updates appear in a separate section distinct from chats, keeping ephemeral content organized away from ongoing conversations. Viewership indicators show who has seen each update, while privacy controls define which contacts have access. 

Cross-device features support messaging on linked devices, allowing users to continue conversations from desktops or secondary devices once they authenticate through their phone. Linked devices maintain access even if the primary device temporarily loses connection, depending on service guidelines. This flexibility supports workflows in which typing on a larger screen or accessing shared files from a computer is preferable. 

Security is maintained through end-to-end encryption applied automatically to messages, calls, and media. This ensures that only the sender and recipient can access the contents of their communication. Encryption operates in the background and does not require manual configuration, providing a protected environment for everyday messaging without altering the interaction model familiar to users. 

Compatibility with Android devices allows the app to operate across a broad range of phones and tablets. It integrates with system-level notifications to surface incoming messages, calls, and media previews. Notification settings can be adjusted for individual chats or groups, offering flexibility for managing interruptions during work or personal time. 

Backup options support preserving chat histories, including messages, images, and other attachments. Users can enable automatic backups at chosen intervals or create them manually. Restoration from a backup allows chat data to reappear on a new device after number verification, dependent on backup availability and user settings. 

Additional tools refine the messaging experience. Wallpaper customization lets users set distinct backgrounds for specific chats or apply global themes. Data usage settings control media auto-download behavior, which can help manage bandwidth consumption in limited-data environments. These configurations allow users to tailor the app’s operation to their preferences while maintaining consistent communication capabilities. 

Group invitation controls and link management features offer structured options for admitting participants into group chats. Administrators can generate invitation links, reset them when necessary, or approve or deny join requests when restricted access is enabled. These controls help maintain group integrity and reduce unwanted additions. 

WhatsApp supports everyday communication through messaging, calling, and media sharing within a familiar chat-based environment. Its structure accommodates personal conversations, ongoing group discussions, and coordinated interaction, making it a consistent tool for routine communication across different contexts.

media.description:
VLC media player is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player that plays most multimedia files as well as discs, devices, and network streaming protocols.

This is the port of VLC media player to the Android™ platform. VLC for Android can play any video and audio files, as well as network streams, network shares and drives, and DVD ISOs, like the desktop version of VLC.

VLC for Android is a full audio player, with a complete database, an equalizer and filters, playing all weird audio formats.

VLC is intended for everyone, is totally free, has no ads, no in-app-purchases, no spying and is developed by passionate volunteers. All the source code is available for free.

Features
––––––––
VLC for Android™ plays most local video and audio files, as well as network streams (including adaptive streaming), DVD ISOs, like the desktop version of VLC. It also support disk shares.

All formats are supported, including MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, Ogg, FLAC, TS, M2TS, Wv and AAC. All codecs are included with no separate downloads. It supports subtitles, Teletext and Closed Captions.

VLC for Android has a media library for audio and video files, and allows to browse folders directly.

VLC has support for multi-track audio and subtitles. It supports auto-rotation, aspect-ratio adjustments and gestures to control volume, brightness and seeking.

It also includes a widget for audio control, supports audio headsets control, cover art and a complete audio media library.

Permissions
––––––––––––
VLC for Android needs access to those categories:
• "Photos/Media/Files" to read your all media files :)
• "Storage" to read your all media files on SD cards :)
• "Other" to check network connections, change the volume, set the ringtone, run on Android TV and display the popup view, see below for details.

Permission Details :
• It needs "read the contents of your USB storage", in to order to read your media files on it.
• It needs "modify or delete the contents of your USB storage", in order to allow deletion of files and store subtitles.

• It needs "full network access", to open network and internet streams.
• It needs "prevent phone from sleeping" in order to prevent... your phone from sleeping when watching a video.
• It needs "change your audio settings", in order to change audio volume.
• It needs "modify system settings", in order to allow you to change your audio ringtone.
• It needs "view network connections" in order to monitor whether device is connected or not.
• It needs "draw over other apps" to start the custom picture-in-picture widget.
• It needs "control vibration" to give feedback on the controls.
• It needs "run at startup" to set recommendations on Android TV launcher screen, only used on Android TV devices.
• It needs "microphone" to provide voice search on Android TV devices, only asked on Android TV devices.
media.summary: VLC for Android is the best open source video and music player, fast and easy!

media.description:
The internet. As it should be.

Firefox is a private web browser designed to protect your data, block trackers and make browsing fast, secure and simple. Whether you’re looking for an incognito browser, a private search experience, or a reliable browser for everyday use, Firefox puts you first.

Why people choose Firefox

More privacy, less tracking – Firefox automatically blocks social media trackers, cross-site cookies, crypto miners and fingerprinting scripts.
Private browsing that protects you – Open private tabs that don’t save your history, searches, or cookies. Lock them with your device security for extra protection.
Fast, smooth performance – Load pages faster by blocking trackers and reducing unnecessary data usage.
 Search your way – Use your preferred private search engine or switch easily from the search bar.
Passwords made simple – Generate, store and autofill passwords securely.
Tabs that work for you – Easily organise and switch between tabs and sync them across devices to pick up where you left off.
Focus without distractions – Reader View strips away clutter, while picture-in-picture lets you multitask with videos.
Control your experience – Add extensions like ad blockers, customise settings and choose how you browse.
Make it yours – Customise your home screen, layout and shortcuts for a more personal browsing experience.
AI on your terms – Turn AI completely off or customise it feature by feature.
Quick page summaries – Shake your phone to cut through long pages and get the key points.
Sync across devices – Access your bookmarks, tabs and passwords anywhere you use Firefox.

Private by default
Firefox is built to protect you. Enhanced Tracking Protection automatically blocks common trackers, while Total Cookie Protection keeps cookies isolated to the sites where they belong. When you need more privacy, private browsing mode ensures your history, searches and cookies aren’t saved. Private tabs can also lock automatically, so your activity stays yours.

Your browser. Your rules.
Firefox puts you in charge of your internet. Add privacy or productivity extensions, including ad blockers, move your search bar, choose your default search engine and tailor your browser to how you use the web. Sync your data across devices for a seamless, consistent experience.

Focus with Firefox. Fast, secure and built around you 
Firefox is designed to help you stay focused with faster, more secure browsing. Reader Mode removes clutter from articles, Picture-in-Picture keeps videos accessible while you multitask and Tracker Blocking helps pages load faster. Built-in password management and private browsing keep everyday browsing simple and protected.

Built for people, not profit
Firefox was created in 2004 by Mozilla as a faster, more private and customisable browser designed to put people first. Today, Mozilla remains a nonprofit working to make the internet — and the time you spend on it — better.

Learn more about Mozilla: https://www.mozilla.org
Terms of Use: https://www.mozilla.org/about/legal/terms/firefox/
Privacy Policy: https://www.mozilla.org/privacy/firefox
Latest news: https://blog.mozilla.org

media.description:
Private Compute Services helps improve features inside Android’s Private Compute core - like Live Caption, Now Playing, and Smart Reply.
Android prevents any feature inside the Private Compute Core from having direct access to the network; but machine learning features often improve by updating models. Private Compute Services helps features get these updates over a private path. Features communicate over open-source APIs to Private Compute Services, which removes identifying information and uses a set of privacy technologies, including federated learning, federated analytics, and private information retrieval, to preserve privacy.
The source code for Private Compute Services is published online at 
https://github.com/google/private-compute-services

media.description:
Instagram is a social media platform centered on visual communication, offering tools for sharing photos, videos, and everyday moments in a format designed for clarity and ease of use. It brings together posting features, content discovery, and private communication in a single environment built around images and short-form media. The platform is available for Android and maintains a streamlined interface focused on browsing updates, viewing stories, interacting with creators, and discovering new content. 

The main feed arranges posts from followed accounts into a continuous scroll, presenting photos and videos in a layout that emphasizes clear presentation and smooth navigation. Captions, tags, and essential engagement options appear in a balanced, unobtrusive structure, allowing users to respond through likes, comments, or basic sharing tools without interrupting the flow of browsing. The feed loads efficiently and maintains consistent readability, creating an environment where personal updates and curated creator content appear side by side. 

Stories occupy the upper section of the interface and offer a space for temporary photo and video posts that disappear automatically after a short period. Gesture-driven navigation enables quick transitions between updates, reflecting the informal rhythm of this format. Lightweight visual tools support simple forms of expression, making it easy to share day-to-day moments without extensive editing. Because Stories are temporary, they complement the permanence of feed posts while encouraging more casual interaction. 

Reels provides an area devoted to short-form videos arranged in a vertical, swipe-based sequence. This section highlights clips that reflect individual interests, ranging from creative or thematic content to brief informative segments. Playback is designed to be seamless, allowing smooth transitions from one clip to the next. Users can interact with videos through likes, comments, or sharing options presented in a consistent, minimal layout. The structure supports quick discovery without overwhelming the broader interface. 

Longer-form video content is available in a separate section where creators publish extended content. Browsing tools organize videos by themes, channels, or profiles, maintaining the platform’s focus on visual continuity. Playback controls remain simple, supporting uninterrupted viewing sessions and making it easy to move between segments of content. 

Posting tools allow users to share photos or videos captured through the built-in camera or selected from the device gallery. Editing capabilities include essential adjustments such as cropping, filters, color refinement, and basic enhancements. These tools aim to keep the workflow intuitive, offering flexibility for refining media without adding unnecessary complexity. Captions, location tags, and accessibility features provide context and help organize shared content within the platform. 

Messaging features offer private communication in one-on-one or group formats. Users can exchange text, images, short videos, and other lightweight media types. Threaded conversations keep discussions organized, and features such as reactions or quick replies support fluid interaction. Because messaging is integrated with the main Instagram account, conversations remain synchronized across supported devices. 

Navigation is structured around familiar tabs for the feed, search, Reels, posting tools, and profile pages. The search area presents a grid-style arrangement of accounts and media categories, grouping content by themes, interests, or trending topics. This environment encourages exploration beyond followed profiles while maintaining an organized layout. Throughout the interface, performance is optimized for smooth operation across Android hardware, prioritizing efficient loading and responsive touch interaction. 

Profile tools allow users to adjust personal details, update bios, change images, and review shared or saved posts. Privacy settings enable switching between public and private account modes and determining who can interact with content. Additional tools for organizing highlighted stories or categorizing saved items enhance personalization while keeping controls easy to navigate. These features support users in shaping their identity on the platform while maintaining appropriate visibility and control. 

Notifications keep users informed about interactions such as comments, likes, tags, and new followers. The interface presents these updates in a clear, structured format that avoids visual clutter. Preferences can be adjusted to refine which alerts appear, helping maintain awareness without introducing unnecessary interruptions. 

Performance is optimized across supported Android devices, with efficient media loading and transitions that reduce strain on system resources. Periodic updates help maintain reliability, refine interface behavior, and ensure compatibility with evolving device standards. 

Together, these features support everyday sharing, discovery, and communication through feeds, Stories, Reels, and messaging, keeping the experience consistent and familiar on Instagram.

media.description:
Control your phone or tablet using switches or the front camera. You can use switches to select items, scroll, enter text and more.

Switch Access helps you interact with your Android device using one or more switches instead of the touchscreen. Switch Access can be helpful if you can't interact directly with your device.

To get started:
1. Open your device's Settings app.
2. Tap Accessibility > Switch Access.

Set up a switch

Switch Access scans the items on your screen and highlights each item until you make a selection. You can choose from a few kinds of switches:

Physical switches
• USB or Bluetooth switches, like buttons or keyboards
• On-device switches, like volume buttons

Camera switches
• Open your mouth, smile or raise your eyebrows
• Look left, right or up

Scan your device

After setting up a switch, you can scan and interact with things on the screen.

• Linear scanning: Move between items one at a time.
• Row-column scanning: Scan one row at a time. After a row is selected, move through items in that list.
• Point scanning: Use moving lines to select a specific horizontal and vertical location, then press 'Select'.
• Group selection: Assign switches to different colour groupings. All items on the screen will be assigned a colour. Press the switch corresponding to the colour around the item that you want. Narrow down the size of the group until you reach your choice.

Use the menus

When an element is selected, you'll see a menu with available interactions, like select, scroll, copy, paste and more.
There will also be a menu at the top of the screen to help you move around your device. For example, you can open notifications, go to the home screen, change the volume and more.

Navigate with camera switches

You can use camera switches to navigate your phone with facial gestures. Browse or select apps on your phone with the use of your phone’s front camera.
You can also customise the sensitivity and duration of each gesture to better fit your needs.

Record shortcuts

You can record touch gestures that can be assigned to a switch or started from a menu. Touch gestures can include pinching, zooming, scrolling, swiping, double tapping and more. You can then start frequent or complex actions with a single switch, for example, recording a gesture that swipes left twice to turn two pages of an eBook.

Permissions notice
• Accessibility service: Because this app is an accessibility service, it can observe your actions, retrieve window content and observe text that you type.

media.description:
CapCut is a mobile video-editing app that provides tools for assembling, adjusting, and refining clips within a dedicated editing workspace. It organizes media selection, timeline controls, and editing options in a layout that keeps core functions within immediate reach. New projects can be created from a start screen where imported footage appears directly in the timeline for editing. 

Inside the editor, the timeline functions as the primary area for arranging and managing clips. Its linear structure supports trimming, splitting, and repositioning segments through simple gestures. Each clip is displayed clearly in sequence, making overall project flow and transition points easy to interpret. Visual indicators highlight selected sections, and the platform provides fine editing controls without relying on complex or multilayered menus. 

Effects and visual adjustments play a key role in shaping each project. The platform also offers tools for modifying speed, applying transitions, or changing clip orientation. Options for filters and color adjustments appear alongside these controls, allowing changes to tone, contrast, or brightness. Users can additionally access overlay features that blend elements such as stickers, shapes, and text into the timeline. Each overlay sits on its own layer, enabling independent adjustments without altering the underlying footage. The platform also incorporates automated features that assist with tasks such as generating captions or refining visual elements, integrating these functions into the same timeline-based workflow. 

Audio tools are integrated into the same timeline-oriented environment. Support is available for adding background tracks, extracting audio from existing video clips, and adjusting volume levels through specific controls. Timing options help align audio cues with visual events, and built-in voice recording allows narration or commentary to be added directly to the project. Recorded audio appears in its own layer, making it easy to reposition or refine. 

Movement and animation settings contribute additional flexibility. The platform provides keyframe tools that allow gradual changes to position, opacity, or scale. These tools help create smooth transitions for visual elements without requiring advanced technical knowledge. Motion effects can be applied to text, stickers, or images, enabling simple animated sequences to be created within the project timeline. 

Templates offer a structured approach to assembling videos efficiently. The app also includes preset formats with predefined timing, transitions, and visual styles. Users can insert their own clips or photos into these layouts, and the project adjusts automatically to the template’s structure. Text, colors, and clip order remain customizable, preserving creative control while simplifying setup. 

The platform provides options for adjusting aspect ratios to match common video formats. Crop and reframing tools appear next to these ratio settings, helping editors maintain the most important parts of each clip when resizing. Export menus present resolution choices and allow completed videos to be saved in formats suitable for broad sharing. Once installed, export settings remain easily accessible across projects without additional configuration. 

Dedicated text tools supply controls for titles, captions, and labels. The app includes a selection of fonts, outlines, shadows, and animation styles. Text elements can be positioned freely on the canvas, with duration controls determining how long they remain visible. Color and style adjustments follow the same streamlined design as other editing components, keeping the workflow consistent. 

Performance-oriented design is present throughout the app. Editing tools load with minimal delay, and preview playback adjusts quality to maintain smooth motion during editing sessions. This structure supports stable operation on a wide range of Android devices. Project settings persist between sessions, allowing work to continue without repeated configuration. 

Settings located in the main interface provide access to options such as default export behavior, cache management, and basic accessibility adjustments. These settings appear in compact menus that avoid unnecessary detail while keeping essential controls available. Users can return to these menus at any time to update preferences based on storage capacity or editing needs. 

Navigation is built around clear sections that prevent overcrowding. The main editor focuses on the timeline and tool strip, while secondary features—including templates, audio tools, or text settings—open in panels that overlay the workspace without interrupting project flow. This approach keeps key functions within reach and reduces frequent switching between screens. 

CapCut supports video editing through a timeline-based workflow that balances accessibility with detailed control. Tools for visual effects, audio, text, and export remain organized around a consistent editing structure, allowing different types of video projects to be assembled and refined within a focused workspace.

Sound Notifications
• Get notified about important sounds around you, like when a smoke alarm beeps or baby cries.

media.description:
Instagram Lite is a lightweight version of Instagram designed to deliver the core experience with lower data and resource usage. It keeps essential features such as browsing posts, sharing photos and short videos, viewing Stories, and direct messaging through a simplified interface focused on speed and clarity. The app is available for Android and is intended to run reliably on devices with limited storage or less stable connections. 

The home feed provides a continuous stream of posts from followed accounts, presenting photos and short videos in a clean layout designed to load with reduced data usage. Everyday browsing remains consistent in lower-bandwidth conditions, with essential interactions such as liking, commenting, and checking basic post information available without unnecessary visual layers. The restrained design helps keep core actions easy to access across a wide range of screen sizes and performance profiles. 

Stories appear at the top of the interface and offer a way to view temporary photo or video updates from friends, creators, and public profiles. This feature mirrors the structure of the main platform while focusing on smooth playback and simple gesture navigation. Visual effects are intentionally modest so the experience stays responsive, supporting quick viewing sessions that align with the app’s lightweight approach. 

Creating posts follows a straightforward workflow. Users can upload photos or brief videos directly from the device gallery and rely on essential editing tools to prepare content. Cropping, rotation, and basic enhancements support simple adjustments without placing heavy demands on processing power. Captions, location tags, and accessibility elements help present posts clearly and keep shared content organized within the platform. 

Messaging is included through a simplified version of direct conversations. Text and media messages can be exchanged, replies appear in threaded format, and ongoing chats are easy to follow. The interface highlights readability and fast loading, avoiding features that would increase data use or reduce performance. Despite this focus on efficiency, conversations remain synced with the user’s Instagram account across devices that support messaging. 

Navigating the app relies on familiar tabs for the feed, search, posting, and profile. This structure minimizes load times and maintains quick access to the main sections. The search area enables exploration of accounts, hashtags, and media categories through concise results pages. Although the discovery experience concentrates on the essentials rather than extensive recommendation layers, it still supports effective browsing for new content that aligns with personal interests. Throughout the interface, compact layouts help ensure smooth responsiveness on a broad range of Android devices. 

Profile tools allow users to update personal information, choose a profile photo, and adjust privacy settings without complexity. Switching between public and private modes, managing who can interact with content, and reviewing shared posts, saved items, or tagged photos remain available. These elements maintain the core structure of Instagram while presenting it in a lighter and more accessible format. 

Notifications appear through a minimal interface that emphasizes clarity. Likes, comments, tags, and follower activity are delivered without visual distractions, and users can adjust notification preferences to balance awareness with control. The simplified handling of alerts helps avoid performance strain while keeping essential updates easy to review. 

Performance optimization is central to Instagram Lite’s design. The app is intended to operate consistently on devices with limited storage, slower processors, or unstable network conditions. Images load efficiently with reduced data consumption, and transitions are kept simple to ensure smooth scrolling. Subsequent updates remain relatively small, helping limit long-term storage impact. 

Additional data-saving options allow the experience to adapt to changing connectivity environments. Users can reduce media preloading, restrict background data use, or adjust how high-resolution content loads. These controls help maintain stable performance in areas with fluctuating network quality, ensuring that essential features remain accessible without unnecessary data usage. 

Instagram Lite preserves the central purpose of Instagram while shaping the experience for speed and efficiency. Browsing photos and videos, discovering accounts, sharing updates, and maintaining conversations all remain intact, presented through an interface designed for clear navigation and reliable performance. Its lightweight structure supports a broad range of Android devices and network conditions, offering a practical way to stay connected with essential social features in a streamlined environment.

media.description:
WhatsApp Business, a free-to-download application, is targeted at small business owners who are looking for an efficient communication tool. Developed as an extension of the renowned WhatsApp Messenger, it is a comprehensive Android app that retains all the familiar features of its predecessor while introducing a set of new capabilities specifically designed for businesses. 

This application is enriched with a Business Profile option that enables you to create a profile for your business. This can serve as a virtual business card, providing your customers with essential information such as your business location, website, and contact details. Moreover, the Business Messaging Tools incorporated in the app offer you the flexibility to be highly responsive to your customers. You can leverage the Away messages to inform your customers of your unavailability, or use the Greeting message to welcome them when they initiate a conversation.

Among the unique offerings of WhatsApp Business is support for landline or fixed phone numbers. This feature allows your customers to send messages to your landline number, offering an innovative way to stay connected. Verification is a breeze - simply choose the "Call me" option to receive the code via a phone call.

A notable advantage of this app is that it allows you to operate both WhatsApp Messenger and WhatsApp Business from the same device, thereby maintaining a clear demarcation between personal and business communications. However, it's important to remember that each application requires a distinct phone number. This not only ensures that your professional and personal interactions remain separate, but also allows you to manage both from a single device.

Adding to the convenience is the WhatsApp Web functionality. With this feature, you can respond to your customers directly from your computer, making the task of managing customer interactions more efficient. Just download the app on your Android device and start using it right away.

While the app download is free, it's worth noting that data charges may apply. Therefore, it's advisable to check with your service provider. Another crucial point to remember is that after restoring chat backup from WhatsApp Messenger to WhatsApp Business, reversing it back isn't possible. Hence, it's recommended to back up the WhatsApp Messenger chats on your computer before initiating the WhatsApp Business download.

In conclusion, WhatsApp Business, available for download on Android, is a comprehensive, robust, and user-friendly app that offers an array of features tailored specifically for small businesses. It not only allows you to manage your business communications effectively but also helps you provide a better customer service experience. Whether it's creating a business profile, using messaging tools, accommodating landline messaging, or managing personal and business accounts on the same device, this app covers it all. However, remember to back up your chats before transitioning from WhatsApp Messenger to WhatsApp Business, and be aware of potential data charges. So go ahead, download WhatsApp Business, and take your business communication to the next level.

media.description:
Facebook Lite is a streamlined version of Facebook designed to provide core social features with reduced data usage and simplified navigation. It focuses on efficient loading and steady performance, particularly on slower networks or devices with limited resources. Compatible with a wide range of Android hardware, the app presents the main feed in a compact layout suited to low-bandwidth conditions. 

The feed acts as the central space for viewing updates from friends, groups, and followed pages. Its simplified structure helps keep scrolling responsive under constrained bandwidth. Text posts, photos, and lightweight media formats load with minimal delay, and the interface includes options for reacting or commenting without navigating away from the current view. Users can also publish their own posts through a pared-down composition panel that supports text entries, image attachments, and location tags within a low-overhead design. 

Communication functions remain integrated in a form tailored for efficiency. The platform provides access to message threads using a layout that conserves data and reduces background activity. Conversations appear in clear threaded form so essential information stays visible without relying on complex transitions or animations. Notifications follow standard device behavior, indicating new activity while avoiding unnecessary data use. Although broader messaging features may be available in separate applications, the Lite interface preserves straightforward access to recent chats and active exchanges. 

Profiles are presented in a clean, condensed format that highlights primary information. Users can view their posts, basic personal details, and a compact image gallery without additional visual layers. The app also includes settings for adjusting visibility controls and managing connections, all of which are arranged to support quick navigation. Profile adjustments—such as updating a cover image or modifying basic information—occur within the same lightweight interface and synchronize across devices linked to the account. 

Group participation is supported through interfaces adapted to low-data environments. Group feeds prioritize text and compressed media, allowing discussions to load quickly even when connectivity is limited. Browsing posts or adding contributions requires minimal visual overhead, and the platform provides tools for group administrators to manage membership or moderate content through straightforward controls. This streamlined structure enables interaction within active communities without placing heavy demands on device performance. 

Events are included in a reduced layout that focuses on clarity. Each listing displays essential details such as date, general description, and host information. Responses rely on simple status selections, and reminders appear through the device’s notification system. After the download is complete and the app becomes part of regular use, the events section continues updating in the background with limited data impact. 

A lightweight marketplace component is incorporated as well, allowing users to browse local listings in a format adjusted for low data consumption. Listings display compressed images, short descriptions, and location details. Filters help refine results by distance or category, and communication with sellers uses the same efficient messaging access available throughout the app. The marketplace remains visually distinct from the social feed to keep navigation clear while preserving minimal interface weight. 

A modest video area is also available, focusing on shorter clips and playback that adapts to lower-bandwidth conditions. The interface prioritizes quick loading and conservative data use while adjusting video quality to match connection strength. Users can follow creators or save items for later viewing, and the video layout functions separately from the main feed to maintain consistent performance. 

Settings follow the Lite app’s emphasis on efficiency. Controls for notifications, privacy preferences, language options, and content filters appear in a concise menu designed to reduce visual complexity. Account management tools, including login oversight and security controls, are integrated into the same streamlined structure. Once installed, these settings can be revisited at any time without affecting overall responsiveness. 

Daily navigation relies on a compact set of icons leading to the app’s primary areas. This approach maintains accessibility while keeping the interface light. Actions such as scrolling, switching sections, viewing discussions, or posting text remain responsive even under restricted bandwidth or on older devices. With simplified visual elements throughout, tasks like uploading photos or browsing conversations proceed with minimal delay. 

Facebook Lite focuses on essential communication and content browsing in a format designed for efficiency. By prioritizing low data usage, simplified navigation, and consistent performance, it supports everyday interaction across feeds, messaging, and community features on a wide range of devices.

media.description:
ANT is a wireless protocol, similar to Bluetooth®, that is predominantly used for sport and fitness wireless connectivity. Pre-installed by the phone manufacturer, this service allows you to connect ANT+ devices to apps on your phone.  ANT Wireless is a division of Garmin Canada Inc.

ANT enabled apps can utilize this service to connect:
• Heart Rate: Receive live heart rate data from heart rate straps or wearables produced by many popular manufacturers
• Fitness Equipment: Connect ANT+ enabled fitness equipment and bicycle trainers to  popular training and workout apps
• Bike Speed and Cadence: Capture bike speed, distance, and/or cadence data
• Bike Power: Capture data from ANT+ cycling power meters such as Garmin Vector  
• Stride-based Speed and Distance Monitor: Capture speed and distance data from running footpods

For a full list of compatible ANT+ apps and devices visit https://www.thisisant.com/directory/

FAQ:
How did this app get on my phone and is it spyware? 
This service is standard software, included by the manufacturer of your phone. It is not illegally downloaded, and it is not spyware. It will not cause system malfunctions or pop-up ads to appear. It is not bloatware and typically uses a max of 20 MB of space. For example, on a 16GB phone, this service takes up 0.0013% of space. We do not pay phone manufacturers to have this service pre-installed. 

How can I remove this service? 
Since this service is standard software, you’re unable to delete it from your phone. Instead, you can disable this service by following the manufacturer’s instructions. The typical process is: settings>applications>application manager>appropriate app>force stop>disable

Disabling this service will not affect your phone’s software. If, in the future, you require the ability to connect to services and devices via ANT+, just enable the service again. 

NOTE: Since this is a factory installed service, it may enable/re-download if you reset and/or update your phone. Don’t panic! Just follow the instructions to disable it again. 

Does this service track me without my knowledge?
No. The ANT Radio Service and ANT+ Plugins Service applications provide a wireless connectivity service, similar to Bluetooth or WiFi, but with very low power. These services do not collect any personal data.

Is it difficult to develop an app with ANT+ capabilities and is there a fee? 
Using the ANT+ plugins in your app to communicate with ANT+ devices is quick, easy, free and uses a simple API. Visit the ANT Android Developer page (http://www.thisisant.com/developer/ant/ant-in-android) for more information and to download the SDK. 

How do I know if I own any ANT enabled products? 
Visit https://www.thisisant.com/directory to search for ANT/ANT+ enabled products, devices and/or services.

media.description:
Voice Access helps anyone who has difficulty manipulating a touch screen (e.g. due to paralysis, tremor, or temporary injury) use their Android device by voice.

Voice Access provides many voice commands for:
- Basic navigation (e.g. "go back", "go home", "open Gmail")
- Controlling the current screen (e.g. "tap next", "scroll down")
- Text editing and dictation (e.g. "type hello", "replace coffee with tea")

You can also say "Help" any time to see a short list of commands.

Voice Access includes a tutorial which introduces the most common voice commands (starting Voice Access, tapping, scrolling, basic text editing, and getting help).

You can use the Google Assistant to start Voice Access by saying "Hey Google, Voice Access". To do this, you’ll need to enable "Hey Google" detection. You can also tap either the Voice Access notification or a blue Voice Access button and start talking.

To pause Voice Access temporarily, just say "stop listening". To disable Voice Access completely, go to Settings > Accessibility > Voice Access and turn off the switch.

For additional support, see Voice Access help.

This app uses the AccessibilityService API to help users with motor impairments. It uses the API to collect information about the controls on the screen and activate them based on the user’s spoken instructions.
media.summary: Provides accessibility by voice for hands-free mobile computing.

media.description:
ANT is a wireless protocol, similar to Bluetooth®, that is predominantly used for sport and fitness wireless connectivity. Pre-installed by the phone manufacturer, this service allows you to connect ANT+ devices to apps on your phone.  ANT Wireless is a division of Garmin Canada Inc.

ANT enabled apps can utilize this service to connect:
• Heart Rate: Receive live heart rate data from heart rate straps or wearables produced by many popular manufacturers
• Fitness Equipment: Connect ANT+ enabled fitness equipment and bicycle trainers to  popular training and workout apps
• Bike Speed and Cadence: Capture bike speed, distance, and/or cadence data
• Bike Power: Capture data from ANT+ cycling power meters such as Garmin Vector  
• Stride-based Speed and Distance Monitor: Capture speed and distance data from running footpods

For a full list of compatible ANT+ apps and devices visit https://www.thisisant.com/directory/

FAQ:
How did this app get on my phone and is it spyware? 
This service is standard software, included by the manufacturer of your phone. It is not illegally downloaded, and it is not spyware. It will not cause system malfunctions or pop-up ads to appear. It is not bloatware and typically uses a max of 20 MB of space. For example, on a 16GB phone, this service takes up 0.0013% of space. We do not pay phone manufacturers to have this service pre-installed. 

How can I remove this service? 
Since this service is standard software, you’re unable to delete it from your phone. Instead, you can disable this service by following the manufacturer’s instructions. The typical process is: settings>applications>application manager>appropriate app>force stop>disable

Disabling this service will not affect your phone’s software. If, in the future, you require the ability to connect to services and devices via ANT+, just enable the service again. 

NOTE: Since this is a factory installed service, it may enable/re-download if you reset and/or update your phone. Don’t panic! Just follow the instructions to disable it again. 

Does this service track me without my knowledge?
No. The ANT Radio Service and ANT+ Plugins Service applications provide a wireless connectivity service, similar to Bluetooth or WiFi, but with very low power. These services do not collect any personal data.

Is it difficult to develop an app with ANT+ capabilities and is there a fee? 
Using the ANT+ plugins in your app to communicate with ANT+ devices is quick, easy, free and uses a simple API. Visit the ANT Android Developer page (http://www.thisisant.com/developer/ant/ant-in-android) for more information and to download the SDK. 

How do I know if I own any ANT enabled products? 
Visit https://www.thisisant.com/directory to search for ANT/ANT+ enabled products, devices and/or services.
media.summary: Enables ANT+ wireless communication for ANT+ enabled apps.

It’s the only app that has communities, events, chats, channels, meetings, storage, tasks, and calendars in one place—so you can easily connect and manage access to information. Get your community, family, friends, or work mates together to accomplish tasks, share ideas, and make plans. Join audio and video calls in a secure setting, collaborate in documents, and store files and photos with built-in cloud storage. You can do it all in Microsoft Teams. 

Easily connect with anyone:

• Manage access to information and ensure the right people have access to the right info, even when people join and leave projects.
• Use task lists to stay on top of projects and plans - assign tasks, set due dates, and cross off items to keep everyone on the same page. 

Designed to give you peace of mind: 
• Securely collaborate with others while maintaining control over your data.

media.description:
Messenger Lite, developed by Facebook, is a stripped-down version of the original Messenger application. It is specifically designed to use less storage space and function more efficiently, making it particularly useful in regions where internet connections are slow or unpredictable. The app is compatible with Android versions 4.0.1 - 4.0.2+ (Ice Cream Sandwich) and later, making it feasible to download Messenger Lite on a wide range of Android devices. 
  
The primary objective behind the development of Messenger Lite was to create a messaging application that is light on storage and data usage, but heavy on functionality. Messenger Lite has the same goal as the standard version: allowing users to communicate with friends and family from all over the world, but making this accessible to everyone disregarding the capacities of their mobile devices. The app is designed to be compact, taking up minimal space on your device. This is particularly beneficial for users with older devices or those with limited storage capacity. Despite its small size, Messenger Lite packs a punch in terms of features. It allows users to send text messages, pictures, and hyperlinks to anyone who uses Messenger, Messenger Lite, or Facebook Lite.  
 
One of the standout features of Messenger Lite is its quick-loading design. Once you download it to your Android device, you’ll notice is lightning fast! The app is engineered to load quickly, making it a faster means of exchanging messages compared to other messaging apps. This is particularly beneficial in regions with slow or unreliable internet connections, where loading times can often be frustratingly long. With Messenger Lite, users can enjoy a smooth, seamless messaging experience, regardless of their internet connection speed. 
  
Another key attribute of Messenger Lite is its prudent use of mobile data. Unlike many other apps that can consume large amounts of data, Messenger Lite is designed to use less. This not only frees up space for other apps but can also potentially reduce your data expenses. This is particularly beneficial for users in regions where data costs are high or where data allowances are limited. 
  
In addition to its data-saving features, Messenger Lite also offers the added benefit of universal network compatibility. The app is specifically tailored for 2G networks and regions with slow or unstable internet connections. This means that even in areas with poor internet connectivity, users can still enjoy a smooth, seamless messaging experience. If a connection is lost, the app will hold your messages and deliver them as soon as a signal is reacquired. This ensures that your messages are always delivered, no matter what. 
  
Furthermore, Messenger Lite can be downloaded and operated on almost any Android phone, regardless of its age or model. This makes the app accessible to a wide range of users, from those with the latest high-end devices to those with older, less powerful phones. This inclusivity is a key part of Messenger Lite's appeal, making it a truly universal messaging solution. 
  
Messenger Lite is an efficient, speedy, and data-friendly messaging application that is compatible with a wide range of Android devices. Its design enables smooth operation even in areas with slow or unstable internet connections, and its compact size and prudent data usage make it an ideal choice for users with limited storage or data allowances. The convenience and efficiency of Messenger Lite make it a must-have download for Android users worldwide. By downloading Messenger Lite, users can open up a world of easy, efficient, and cost-effective communication. Whether you're looking to stay in touch with friends and family, or simply want a reliable, efficient messaging app, Messenger Lite is a fantastic choice.

"Where is my Train" is a unique train app that displays live train status and up-to-date schedules. The app can function offline without needing Internet or GPS.  It is also packed with useful features such as destination alarms and a speedometer. Thank you to all the users who make the app better every day by sharing their feedback with us.
  
Spotting Train Accurately 
 
Get live train status of Indian Railways anytime, anywhere. When you are traveling on a train, this feature can work without internet or GPS as it uses cell tower information to find the location. You can share current train location with your friends & family via the share feature. You can also set an alarm to wake you up at a fixed time before your railway station arrives. 
 
Offline Train Schedules
 
The train app has the Indian Railways timetable offline. You don't have to know train number or names as our Smart search feature allows you to use train source & destination or partial train names even with spelling errors.

Metro and Local Trains
Now see the latest correct schedules and real time location of Local Trains and Metros in your city.  

Coach Layout and Platform numbers
 	
Get information on coach position and seat/berth layout before you board the train. Also shows platform numbers for boarding and intermediate stations wherever available.
 
Super efficient in Battery, Data Usage and App size
 
The app is very efficient in battery and data use as key features like finding train locations and schedules can work offline without Internet or GPS. The app-size is relatively small despite having a lot of information offline.
 
 
Seat Availability and PNR Status 
 
Check seat availability and PNR status on the official Indian Railways website within the app. 
  
Disclaimer: The app is privately maintained and does not have any affiliation whatsoever to Indian Railways.

media.description:
The Health Platform is an Android-based mobile/Watch platform service that helps you collect and manage your personal health data generated by various health apps. Health Platform supports Health Data API provided by Google to enable health apps to manage health data securely on the device. Health Platform supports Samsung devices only.

Storing data
Health data measured or recorded from various health apps on smartphones as well as from smartwatches can be stored on the Health Platform. (Types of data supported: heart rate, oxygen saturation, blood sugar, blood pressure, body weight, sleep, steps, distance walked, calories burned, intake information, etc.)

Syncing data
Try setting the data syncing (sending/receiving data) on the settings screens of various health apps that support the Health Platform. Health data stored on the Health Platform can be shared with various health apps.

Backing up data
Log in to your Samsung account to back up your health data safely. Any health data collected on the server is not used for any purpose other than for backup purposes.

Start your first syncing on Samsung Health!

Usage Environment 
Health Platform supports Samsung devices only.
Tablets and some mobile devices are not supported, and detailed features may vary depending on the user’s country of residence, region, network carrier, model of the device, etc. 
This service is available in approximately 70 languages, including English, French, and Chinese, and the English version is provided for regions that use other languages. 

By default, access permission as follows is required to offer the service. In the case of optional access permissions, basic features of the service can be used even if they are not granted.

[Mandatory Access Permission]
- Physical activity: Used to count your steps or to detect movement

 [Optional Access Permission] 
- Body measurement sensor: Used to measure heart rate, body mass index, electrocardiogram, etc. 
- Contacts: Used to confirm Samsung account login status 
- Storage: Used to download health data from the backup server and store it in your device, or to store health data as a file when using the 'Download personal data' feature.

Supported Devices:  
- Samsung Mobile devices over Android O
- Wear OS devices powered by Samsung

media.description:
Battlegrounds Mobile India, widely known as BGMI, is an online battle royale game where the ultimate objective is to outlast all opponents and claim victory. The game challenges players to showcase survival instincts, tactical decision-making, and sharp reflexes in fast-paced matches. Developed by KRAFTON, Inc., BGMI is designed exclusively for Android devices and is free to download, making it accessible to a vast gaming community across the country.

The world of BGMI unfolds in a visually rich 3D environment, featuring high-definition graphics and immersive sound effects that pull players into each match. Maps are meticulously designed, ranging from dense tropical jungles to sprawling urban landscapes and desolate wastelands. Every match feels dynamic because the environment constantly shapes the strategies players must adopt. Weapons, vehicles, and gear are rendered with striking realism, while smooth mechanics ensure that combat and movement remain fluid even during intense battles. This careful design helps create a gaming experience that feels authentic and captivating.

Among its standout features, BGMI continues to evolve with innovative themed modes. The Shadow Force Theme Mode, for example, allows players to embrace the persona of a futuristic warrior equipped with a katana-inspired energy blade. This weapon is not only a formidable melee option but also has defensive capabilities, enabling players to block incoming projectiles. Alongside this, BGMI includes mechanics such as clone summoning, which introduces fresh layers of unpredictability and tactical depth. These elements keep each match exciting and prevent gameplay from becoming repetitive.

Progression and rewards are central to BGMI's engagement. The latest Royale Pass A4: Snowfall Supreme enhances the in-game experience by offering exclusive outfits, weapon skins, and themed items to those who complete missions. This system encourages consistent play while providing a sense of achievement. For players who enjoy cricket, BGMI also integrates cultural themes with features like the Cricket 33 Crate, combining the thrill of sport with the adrenaline of battle royale. Such seasonal additions ensure the game feels fresh and relevant, aligning with the interests of its Indian player base.

KRAFTON consistently delivers updates that refine the overall experience. Technical improvements address issues like latency, sound synchronization, or animation glitches, ensuring stability during gameplay. These updates are also opportunities to introduce new modes, balance adjustments, or seasonal events, keeping the community engaged and eager for what's next. This commitment to maintenance and evolution demonstrates how seriously the developers treat player feedback and performance optimization.

Personalization remains a core part of BGMI. Players have a broad selection of customization options for both their characters and weapons. Outfits, accessories, skins, and emotes allow individuals to create unique avatars that reflect their style, while weapon cosmetics provide a sense of ownership and flair. This layer of creativity not only deepens immersion but also builds player identity within the game's global community.

BGMI offers a range of modes tailored to different playstyles. Solo mode is ideal for those who prefer testing individual skills, while duo mode adds a cooperative element for paired strategy. Squad mode, one of the most popular, emphasizes teamwork, coordination, and communication, enabling groups of four to plan tactics and support one another in high-stakes matches. Beyond competitive play, the training ground provides a valuable space for both newcomers and seasoned players to experiment with weapons, vehicles, and mechanics before entering live matches.

Social connection is another strong pillar of BGMI. The ability to create teams, join clans, and connect with friends fosters a sense of belonging beyond the battlefield. In-game chat and voice communication tools enable players to coordinate in real time, which not only enhances tactical efficiency but also makes the game more enjoyable through shared experiences. For many, BGMI has become more than just a game—it is a virtual hub for interaction, bonding, and teamwork.

Battlegrounds Mobile India remains one of the most engaging mobile games available today. Its combination of cutting-edge graphics, evolving features, cultural integration, and regular updates ensures that it continues to captivate millions of players. The accessibility of a free download further broadens its appeal, making it a go-to choice for casual gamers and dedicated enthusiasts alike.

Blending action, strategy, and survival into one package, BGMI delivers a challenging yet rewarding experience for every type of player. Whether you're stepping onto the battlefield for the first time or refining advanced tactics with your squad, this game offers endless opportunities for thrill and achievement. With its detailed environments, inventive modes, and strong community focus, Battlegrounds Mobile India stands as a must-download title that continues to shape the future of mobile gaming in India.

■ How to Read News from Your Own Country/Region ■

media.description:
Family Link parental controls is the companion app to Family Link for parents. Please only download this app to a device being used by a child or teen.

  Try the Family Link parental controls app from Google. Whether your children are adolescents or young adults, the Family Link app lets you set digital ground rules remotely from your own device to help guide them as they learn, play and explore online. For children under the age of 13 (or the 
applicable age of consent in your country
), Family Link also lets you create a Google Account for your child that's like your account, with access to most Google services.

  With Family Link parental controls, you can:

  Guide them towards appropriate content

  • View their app activity − Not all screen time is the same. Help your child make healthy decisions about what they decide to do on their Android device, with activity reports displaying how much time they're spending on their favourite apps. You can see daily, weekly or monthly reports.
  • Manage their apps − Handy notifications let you approve or block apps that your child wants to download from the Google Play Store. You can also manage in-app purchases and hide specific apps on their device all remotely from your own device.
  • Feed their curiosity – It can be hard to decipher which apps are right for your child, so Family Link shows you teacher-recommended apps on Android that you can add directly to their device.

  Keep an eye on screen time

  • Set limits − It's up to you to decide the right amount of screen time for your child. Family Link lets you set time limits and a bedtime for their supervised devices, so you can help them find a good balance.
  • Lock their device − Whether it's time to go and play outside, have dinner or just spend time together, you can remotely lock a supervised device whenever it's time to take a break.

  See where they are

  • It's helpful to be able to find your child when they're on the go. You can use Family Link to help locate them as long as they're carrying their Android device.

  Important information

  • Family Link's tools vary depending on your child's device. See a list of compatible devices at families.google.com/familylink/setup
  • While Family Link helps you manage your child's purchases and downloads from Google Play, they won't need approval to install app updates (including updates that expand permissions), apps that you have previously approved or apps that have been shared in Family Library. Parents should regularly review their child's installed apps and app permissions in Family Link.
  • You should carefully review the apps on your child's supervised device and disable those that you don't want them to use. Note that you may not be able to disable some pre-installed apps.
  • To see the location of your child or teenager's device, it must be powered on, recently active and connected to the Internet.
  • Teacher-recommended apps are only available on Android devices in the US and to parents of children of certain ages.
  • While Family Link provides tools to manage your child's online experience, it doesn't make the Internet safe. Instead, it is intended to give parents choices about how their children use the Internet and to encourage conversations about Internet use.

media.description:
PUBG Mobile Lite is a free battle royale game for Android devices, specially designed by PUBG Corporation for players with low to mid-range smartphones. It is completely free to download and offers the same thrill and intensity of the original PUBG Mobile but in a more optimized version that consumes less power, memory, and storage. With PUBG Mobile Lite, anyone can join the battle and enjoy the same survival challenge without needing high-end hardware.

Built on the powerful Unreal Engine 4, PUBG Mobile Lite delivers a smooth and visually engaging experience even on devices with limited resources. Unlike the standard version, this lighter edition is crafted to run efficiently on phones with as little as 1GB of RAM and just 500MB of storage space. Once you download the game, you will discover that it still maintains fast-paced matches, immersive environments, and a competitive atmosphere, ensuring no one misses out on the fun. The goal is simple: land, loot, and survive until the very end.

In PUBG Mobile Lite, each match begins with up to 60 players parachuting into a 2x2 km map. This map is smaller than the ones in the original PUBG Mobile, but it is still filled with a wide variety of weapons, vehicles, and survival gear. This condensed battleground makes matches shorter, faster, and more action-packed, usually lasting about 10 minutes. From the moment you land, every decision counts. Should you loot quickly and arm yourself with an M416 or AKM, or hide and wait for the perfect moment to strike? With fewer players and tighter spaces, the tension builds up quickly, offering nonstop adrenaline.

The main attraction of PUBG Mobile Lite lies in its two exciting modes: Classic Battle Royale and Arena Mode. Classic Mode sticks to the formula that made PUBG famous: 60 players fighting to be the last survivor. The map, Erangel, may look familiar but has been redesigned to suit shorter matches and more dynamic gameplay. On the other hand, Arena Mode offers non-stop 4v4 action with unlimited respawns. This mode is perfect for players who want instant combat and quick challenges rather than the longer survival-focused battles. Both modes give you plenty of variety right after downloading the game.

Fair play is a core principle of PUBG Mobile Lite. The game integrates a strong anti-cheat system that constantly monitors matches and prevents unfair tactics or hacks. This ensures that your victories are based on skill, strategy, and teamwork rather than exploits. Whether you win by carefully planning your moves or by charging into battle, you can always count on a fair gaming environment.

Despite being designed for lower-end devices, PUBG Mobile Lite doesn't compromise on visuals and sound. Thanks to Unreal Engine 4, the graphics are smooth, clear, and detailed, bringing the battlegrounds to life. From the textures of landscapes to the sound of distant gunfire, the game provides an immersive experience that pulls you into the heart of the action. To fully appreciate the high-quality audio, voice chat, and environmental effects, it is highly recommended to play with headphones.

Another great feature is the teamplay option. PUBG Mobile Lite allows you to squad up with your friends using real-time voice chat. Planning ambushes, calling for backup, or coordinating attacks in real time enhances the thrill and strategy of each match. It also makes the game more social and engaging, allowing you to share victories and memorable moments with your teammates.

What keeps PUBG Mobile Lite fresh and exciting is its constant updates and seasonal events. The developers frequently release new content such as limited-time game modes, special skins, rewards, and even fresh maps. These regular additions ensure that no two matches ever feel the same and that players always have something new to look forward to. Whether you're taking part in themed events or just playing casually, there's always something to keep you hooked.

PUBG Mobile Lite is not just a simplified version of PUBG Mobile — it is its own unique experience. It blends quick matches, optimized performance, and intense battles, all packed into a lightweight download that fits most Android devices. If you want to experience the thrill of survival, the excitement of intense combat, and the satisfaction of being the last one standing, then PUBG Mobile Lite is the game for you. Gather your squad, drop into the island, and prove your skills. Don't wait — download PUBG Mobile Lite now and step onto the battleground!

VPN related introduction

A virtual private network (VPN) extends a private network across a public network, and enables users to send and receive data across shared or public networks as if their computing devices were directly connected to the private network. Applications running across the VPN may therefore benefit from the functionality, security, and management of the private network.

Individual Internet users may secure their transactions with a VPN, to circumvent geo-restrictions and censorship, or to connect to proxy servers for the purpose of protecting personal identity and location. However, some Internet sites block access to known VPN technology to prevent the circumvention of their geo-restrictions.

VPNs cannot make online connections completely anonymous, but they can usually increase privacy and security. To prevent disclosure of private information, VPNs typically allow only authenticated remote access using tunneling protocols and encryption techniques.

Mobile virtual private networks are used in settings where an endpoint of the VPN is not fixed to a single IP address, but instead roams across various networks such as data networks from cellular carriers or between multiple Wi-Fi access points. Mobile VPNs have been widely used in public safety, where they give law enforcement officers access to mission-critical applications, such as computer-assisted dispatch and criminal databases, while they travel between different subnets of a mobile network.

A virtual private network (VPN) extends a private network across a public network, and enables users to send and receive data across shared or public networks as if their computing devices were directly connected to the private network. Applications running across the VPN may therefore benefit from the functionality, security, and management of the private network.

Individual Internet users may secure their transactions with a VPN, to circumvent geo-restrictions and censorship, or to connect to proxy servers for the purpose of protecting personal identity and location. However, some Internet sites block access to known VPN technology to prevent the circumvention of their geo-restrictions.

VPNs cannot make online connections completely anonymous, but they can usually increase privacy and security. To prevent disclosure of private information, VPNs typically allow only authenticated remote access using tunneling protocols and encryption techniques.

Mobile virtual private networks are used in settings where an endpoint of the VPN is not fixed to a single IP address, but instead roams across various networks such as data networks from cellular carriers or between multiple Wi-Fi access points. Mobile VPNs have been widely used in public safety, where they give law enforcement officers access to mission-critical applications, such as computer-assisted dispatch and criminal databases, while they travel between different subnets of a mobile network.

When your device is charged and powered on again, calls will no longer be forwarded.

UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) is envisaged to make e-governance 'mobile first'. It is developed by Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and National e-Governance Division (NeGD).
                                                                                                     
It is an evolving platform designed for citizens of India to offer them access to the pan-India e-Gov services from the Central, State, Local Bodies, and Agencies of government on app, web, SMS, and IVR channels.
 
Key Features:
- Unified Platform: It brings together all government departments and their services on a single platform to provide better and easier services to citizens.
- Mobile First Strategy: It aligns all government services with the mobile first strategy to leverage mobile adoption trends.    
- Integration with Digital India Services: It provides seamless integration with other Digital India Services like Aadhaar, DigiLocker, and PayGov. Any new such service will automatically be integrated with the platform.
- Uniform Experience: It is designed to enable citizens to discover, download, access, and use all government services easily.
- Secure and Scalable: It supports Aadhaar-based and other authentication mechanisms for service access. The sensitive profile data is saved in an encrypted format and no one can view this information.               
 
Key Services:
UMANG provides easy access to a plethora of Indian government services ranging from – Healthcare, Finance, Education, Housing, Energy, Agriculture, Transport to even Utility and Employment and Skills.
 
Key Benefits for Citizens:
- Single-Point Ubiquitous Access: All government services are available for citizens on a unified platform for easy access through multiple online and offline channels (SMS, email, app, and web).      
- More for Less: Only a single mobile app needs to be installed instead of each app of each department.
- Convenience: Citizens do not even need to install or update the app again to avail government services if more services are added to the platform.
- Saving of Time and Money: Citizens can anytime and anywhere avail these services through their mobile phones, desktops, and laptops without any need for visiting the department office and standing in queues.
- Uniform Experience: All the government services including payment-based transactions provide secure and uniform experience.

Q: Why don't the widget, the alarm and notes remider functions work?

If you have already moved the app to an SD card, but want those features, then you have to move the app back on the device and reboot your phone.

Q: I forgot my master password. How can I change it?

Either approve the notification sent to the Microsoft Authenticator, or enter the one-time password (OTP) generated by the app. The one-time passwords (OTP codes) have a 30 second timer counting down. This timer is so you never have to use the same time-based one-time password (TOTP) twice and you don’t have to remember the number. The one-time password (OTP) doesn’t require you to be connected to a network, and it won’t drain your battery. You can add multiple accounts to your app, including non-Microsoft accounts like Facebook, Amazon, Dropbox, Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, and more.

Getting started with passwordless

Use your phone, not your password, to log into your Microsoft account. Just enter your username, then approve the notification sent to your phone. Your fingerprint, face ID, or PIN will provide a second layer of security in this two-step verification process. After you’ve signed in with two factor authentication (2FA), you’ll have access to all your Microsoft products and services, such as Outlook, OneDrive, Office, and more.

Microsoft personal, work or school accounts

Sometimes your work or school might ask you to install the Microsoft Authenticator when accessing certain files, emails, or apps. You will need to register your device to your organization through the app and add your work or school account. Microsoft Authenticator also supports cert-based authentication by issuing a certificate on your device. This will let your organization know that the sign-in request is coming from a trusted device and help you seamlessly and securely access additional Microsoft apps and services without needing to log into each. Because Microsoft Authenticator supports single sign-on, once you have proven your identity once, you will not need to log in again to other Microsoft apps on your device.

Optional Access Permissions

Microsoft Authenticator includes the following optional access permissions. All these require user consent. If you choose to not grant these optional access permissions, you can still use Microsoft Authenticator for other services that do not require such permission. For more information see https://aka.ms/authappfaq

Location: Sometimes your organization wants to know your location before allowing you to access certain resources. The app will request this permission only if your organization has a policy requiring location.

Camera: Used to scan QR codes when you add a work, school, or non-Microsoft account.

Read the contents of your storage: This permission is only used when you report a technical problem through the app settings. Some information from your storage is collected to diagnose the issue.

Family Link's easy-to-use tools allow you to understand how your child is spending time on their device, see their device location, manage privacy settings and more.

  • Secure their account – Family Link gives you access to manage your child's account and data settings. As a parent, you can help change or reset your child's password if they forget it, edit their personal information or even delete their account if you feel that it's necessary.
  
  • See where they are – it's helpful to be able to find your family when they're on the go. With Family Link, you can locate your children on one map, as long as they're carrying their device.

  • You should carefully review the apps on your child's supervised device, and disable those that you don't want them to use. Note that you may not be able to disable some pre-installed apps such as Play, Google, etc.

  • While Family Link provides tools to manage your child's online experience and keep them safer online, it does not make the Internet safe. Family Link cannot determine the content on the Internet, but it can give parents the opportunity to make decisions about how their child spends time on their device and determine what path to online safety looks best for your family.

BASIC CONTROLS
The game features an interactive tutorial that you are advised to play through, but the basic controls are as follows:
CURSORS = Movement (double-tap to dash)
A = Attack (with a direction to aim high, without to aim low)
G = Grapple
R = Run
P = Pick-Up / Drop (with a direction to throw)
T = Taunt / Pin / Referee duties
EYE = Change focus / Turn opponent around
HEALTH METER = Switch character
CLOCK = Pause / Change camera angle
